events.title: In the Room: Sixty Years on the Front Lines of History
events.description: Roosevelt understood the camera before most politicians did. He posed in buckskin in the Badlands, stood with John Muir at Yosemite, and left behind one of the most photographed lives of his century. David Hume Kennerly has spent sixty years doing the other half of that job — from the Vietnam battlefields that earned him the Pulitzer, to the Ford White House, to nearly every administration since. The special exhibition, drawn from his book In the Room, opens at the Library in October.

events.title: Early Voting
events.description:
The TR Site is proud to partner with the Erie County Board of Elections to serve as an Early Voting Site for the 2026 General Election.

Any registered Erie County (NY) voter — regardless of where they live — can vote early at the TR Site. Questions about voter eligibility should be directed to the Erie Co. Board of Elections (716) 858-8891.

The TR Site will also host a dedicated and colorful voting booth as part of the Kids Voting USA initiative, a nonpartisan voter education program committed to creating lifelong voting habits in children.

**PLEASE NOTE** Early Voting Hours are as follows:

Saturday, October 24th thru Sunday, November 1st

Weekdays (Mon -Fri) | 12 Noon – 9:00 pm

Weekends (Sat & Sun) | 9:00 am – 5:00 pm
events.cost_note: Must be a registered voter in Erie Co, NY

events.title: Theodore Roosevelt's Birthday Celebration
events.description:
Join us on Saturday, October 24th and Sunday, October 25th to celebrate Theodore Roosevelt’s 168th birthday! If you come to the Birthplace dressed as TR on either day, you will receive a small “birthday present” to take home! There will also be free crafts, a photo op station, and a children’s storytime held at 10:15 AM and 1:00 PM on both days!

Theodore Roosevelt Bithplace is at 28 East 20th Street, New York, NY 10003. The site is open from 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Free first-come, first-served house tours are available at 11:00, 12:00, 2:00, and 3:00. Space for these tours is limited. Questions? Please email thrb_info@nps.gov or visit www.nps.gov/thrb.

events.title: Guided Grounds Tour
events.description: Step back in time with the Roosevelts and hear stories about their lives at Sagamore Hill. This will be a 30-45 minute guided walk around the grounds of Sagamore Hill. The tour will begin at the picnic area, with stops at important buildings and places on the Roosevelt property. This walk will take place outside, please dress accordingly and bring water.
events.cost_note: This is a free guided walk of the Sagamore Hill grounds.

venue.name: Sagamore Hill National Historic Site
venue.address: Meet at the picnic area by the parking lot.

events.organizer: Sagamore Hill National Historic Site

extra.reservation_info: No reservation is required.
